review_method: Visual inspection of every second decoded frame across the entire MP4 plus native-resolution transition frames, followed by native initial PNG
initial_scene: Middle third-person view: an orange-covered work surface holds a shallow green plate toward the upper left and a bunch of purple grapes to its right. The active white-and-blue robotic arm with an open two-finger gripper is at the rear right; another arm is visible in the lower-left foreground. Black curtains and gray table edges surround the work surface.

observed_sequence.action: The active arm begins above the back-right portion of the table and moves its open gripper toward the grape bunch; the green plate is empty.
The gripper descends to straddle the grape bunch on the orange surface.
The fingers close around the grapes and hold near the table before lifting; the bunch remains in the same tabletop area during most of this interval.
The arm lifts the whole grape bunch clear of the orange surface in its gripper.
The arm carries the suspended grape bunch leftward to the green plate and lowers it onto the plate.
The fingers open and release the grape bunch onto the green plate; the bunch rests across the plate with its right end extending past the rim.
The empty open gripper lifts and withdraws toward the rear-right area; the grapes remain resting on the green plate through the final frame.

selected_segment.reason: The source contains one continuous complete grape pick-and-place, followed only by withdrawal, so the entire single action is retained.
selected_segment.terminal_state: The bunch of grapes rests on the green plate, with its right end extending beyond the rim, while the open empty gripper is clear of it.
